type.doc: Choose the type of the object.

value.doc: Choose the value assigned to the object.

dimensions.doc: Physical dimensions of the field: [kg m s K mol A cd].

internalField.doc: Initial value of the field in the domain interior.

boundaryField.doc: Boundary conditions of the field, one sub-dictionary per patch.

uniform.doc: Marks a field value that is constant in space.

libs.doc: Additional shared-object libraries to load at solver start.

application.doc: The solver this case is set up for.

startFrom.doc: Where to pick the simulation start time from.

startTime.doc: Start time of the simulation (used with startFrom startTime).

endTime.doc: End time of the simulation (used with stopAt endTime).

purgeWrite.doc: Keep only the most recent N time directories (0 keeps all).

timePrecision.doc: Significant figures in time directory names.

runTimeModifiable.doc: Re-read dictionaries at the start of each time step.

adjustTimeStep.doc: Let the solver adapt deltaT to honour maxCo.

maxCo.doc: Maximum Courant number when adjustTimeStep is active.

maxDeltaT.doc: Upper bound on the adapted time step.

default.doc: Fallback scheme applied when no specific entry matches.

solvers.doc: Linear solver settings, one sub-dictionary per matrix/field.

tolerance.doc: Absolute residual at which the linear solve stops.

relTol.doc: Relative residual reduction at which the linear solve stops (0 disables).

PISO.doc: Settings for the PISO pressure-velocity coupling loop.

SIMPLE.doc: Settings for the SIMPLE steady-state coupling loop.

PIMPLE.doc: Settings for the merged PISO-SIMPLE coupling loop.

relaxationFactors.doc: Under-relaxation factors for fields and equations.

residualControl.doc: Convergence criteria for SIMPLE/PIMPLE outer loops.

convertToMeters.doc: Scaling factor applied to all vertex coordinates.

scale.doc: Scaling factor applied to all vertex coordinates (newer name).

blocks.doc: Hex block definitions: vertex ordering, cell counts, grading.

boundary.doc: Boundary patches: name, type and face lists.

mergePatchPairs.doc: Pairs of patches to merge into internal faces.

numberOfSubdomains.doc: How many processors to decompose the case for.

preservePatches.doc: Patches to keep on a single processor (e.g. cyclics).

type.doc: Boundary condition type for this patch.
